Hello {name},

This is a friendly reminder of your dental appointment on {date} at {time}.

If you need to reschedule, just reply to this email or call us.

Kind regards,
The dental clinic
reminders.recallWhatsapp: Hello {name}, it has been {months} months since your last check-up. Would you like to book an appointment? We would be glad to see you.
reminders.recallEmailBody:
Hello {name},

Our records show your last visit was {last}. A check-up every few months keeps small problems small.

Just reply to this email or call us to book a time that suits you.

Kind regards,
The dental clinic
reminders.followUpWhatsapp: Hello {name}, it has been {days} days since your treatment. How are you feeling? Let us know if anything is bothering you.
reminders.followUpEmailSubject: How are you feeling after your treatment?

Hello {name},

It has been {days} days since we treated you ({services}). We wanted to check how you are getting on.

If anything is painful or does not feel right, reply to this email or call us and we will see you.

Kind regards,
The dental clinic

backup.title: Backup
backup.description: Download every record as one file. Keep a copy somewhere other than this computer.
backup.passphraseHint: Leave blank for a plain, readable JSON file.
backup.warning: If you set a passphrase and forget it, the backup cannot be recovered. Staff PINs and uploaded files are not included.
backup.checkDescription: Open a backup file to prove it still works — that it decrypts with the passphrase you think it has, and that the practice is really inside it. Nothing is written; this only reads the file.
backup.checkPassphraseHint: Needed only if the backup was encrypted. This is the thing worth testing — a passphrase is discovered to be wrong on the one day it cannot be fixed.
backup.checkGood: This backup opens and holds the practice.
backup.checkTooLarge: That file is too large to check here.
backup.checkNeedsPassphrase: That file is encrypted — enter the passphrase it was made with.
backup.checkBadPassphrase: That passphrase does not open this file. The file may also have been damaged in transit.
backup.checkNotABackup: That is not a backup made by this app.
backup.checkUnreadable: That file could not be read.
backup.checkNoPatients: There are no patients in this file — it is most likely a backup of an empty database rather than of this practice.
backup.checkNewerVersion: This file was written by a newer version of the app than the one running here.
backup.checkAuditTruncated: The activity trail in this file was cut short when it was written. The rest is archived beside the patient files.
backup.checkExcludes: Staff PINs and uploaded files are never inside a backup — the files are copied separately with the storage directory.
backup.checkRestoreNote: Putting a backup back is done into an empty database, not over a live one — see docs/RESTORE.md and prisma/restore-backup.ts.

backupStatus.localOnly: This server only — not a backup

messageTemplates.body_RECALL:
Hello {name},

It has been a while since your last check-up. A visit every few months keeps small problems small.

Reply to this message and we will find a time that suits you.

{signature}
messageTemplates.body_RUNNING_LATE:
Hello {name},

We are running behind today, so your appointment at {time} will start a little later than planned. We are sorry to keep you waiting.

Reply to this message if you would rather come another day.

{signature}
messageTemplates.body_POST_OP:
Hello {name},

We wanted to check how you are getting on after your treatment. A few days of tenderness is normal.

If anything is painful or does not feel right, reply to this message and we will see you.

{signature}
